dataList.content:
The door is shut.
紧闭的门。

Something just occurred to me.
突然，这样的念头闪过脑海。

That a heavy, adamantine door stood between Sancho and I, tightly shut.
在桑丘和我对话的时候，好似有一扇紧闭的、厚重的门存在于我们之间。

Whatever I said wouldn't reach her, and she had no wish to open the door. We stood there in a stalemate.
无论我用什么话语劝导都触及不到她，她也不打算从另一侧将门打开，我们就这样僵持着。
The Sinners would conceal their troubles, shy away from attempts to understand them, but... in the end, they all wanted something. 至今为止……罪人们隐藏着他们的问题，逃避着理解……但是心中抱有某种期待。

There was this certain faith that I, as their manager, would be able to do something for them.
那是他们对作为经理的我能做到些什么的信任。

Or at least that they would find their wishes granted at the end of each of their flow.
或者是在流向的尽头能够实现自身愿望的信任。

Yes. They all had dreams.
没错，他们都有着梦。

He no longer wanted to be an outcast. She wanted to be special. He wanted to confront his past.
想要归属某处。想要变得特别。想要面对过去。

He wanted to change. She wanted to sail onward, unanchored. He wanted to mend the two hearts broken apart.
想要改变。不想被埋没。想让相悖的心再次复原。

And every time, I reached out. I cried out loud each of their dreams to them, and, with some luck, managed to turn them away from the brink.
我向罪人们喊着这样的梦，将想法传递给他们，然后好几次……如果运气好，能将他们引回正途。

But... to Don Quixote, whose dream has already ended... Only now do I realize that I have nothing to give her, nothing to tell her.
然而对于梦已终结的堂吉诃德来说，我现在才明白自己没有任何可以向她传达的话语。

My role stopped at breaking through each Sinner's barriers to retrieve their lost dreams, squeezing them past the doors to their hearts that remained open still, no matter how narrow the gaps were.
结果，我的角色仅限于闯入罪人们那失去的梦中，将他们从那门缝中拉出来而已。

I have never given them something new to dream about.
我从未亲自给予过他们新的梦。

<Don... Quixote...>
<堂吉……诃德……>
dataList.place:
Fathoms of Ego - La Mancha Eye
自我心道 - 拉·曼却之眼

dataList.content:
I'll tell you again. That is not who I am.
再说一遍……我不是那个人。

That fool who used to twinkle her eyes at you, shoving some ridiculous idea of a dream before you is dead.
那个两眼泛光、向你谈论着愚蠢的梦的人已经不在了。

... Has Don Quixote's dream ended?
……堂吉诃德的梦终结了吗。

Has the dream of the other Don Quixote, who lies there with his body impaled by so many stakes... ended?
那边那个全身被贯穿的堂吉诃德的梦也终结了吗。

What if the dream still... continues?
但是，如果梦还在……继续着呢？

<Sinclair…?>
<辛克莱……？>

My dream...
梦……

It ripened and ripened until the rot set in. Thus it fell to the earth and burst.
因为太过熟透而坠落了。

It is broken. All that remains is the decaying carcass of the dream.
不再继续了。我眼前所见的，只有腐烂而破裂的梦之残骸。

Sancho's lifeless eyes gaze into the distant hollow, seeing nothing in the futility that extends far beyond the horizon.
桑丘的眼睛如同死去那般浑浊，仿佛凝视着遥远彼方的虚无。

But... Sinclair redirects her gaze toward himself.
但是……辛克莱让那视线回到了他自己身上。

La Manchaland manifests to devour humans, yeah... but it eventually disappears again.
众所周知，拉·曼却领虽然会在人们面前出现，但同时……也会消失。

Look, on one hand, it's trying to hurt us humans. But on the other hand... it keeps trying to hide away, too.
虽然其在尝试伤害人类……但也在试图遮掩自身的存在……

Even as he lies there, his body torn apart by thousands of stakes... he's been trying.
哪怕被无数的木桩所刺穿，他也……一直如此。

Perhaps your 'Father'... even he— Maybe he—
连你父亲这样的人都是如此，或许……

This... is what I think we must do.
所以……我想……

... We have to go back.
我们，应该再去一次。

To the birthplace of that dream.
去往那一切梦的起点。

The tightly shut door suddenly shook.
突然，我感到那紧闭的门扉像是晃动了一下。

And in front of it stood Sinclair.
不知何时，站在那扇门前的成了辛克莱。

A familiar red sign, though incomplete, briefly flickered from his forehead...
虽然并不完整，但辛克莱的额头上短暂地浮现出了熟悉的红色印记……

... and a blinding white light surrounded him. Sinclair was...
然后那个放出雪白而耀眼光芒的人……

<The Knight of the White Moon.>
<白月骑士。>

... Bari.
……巴里。

I haven't... uttered that name... in such a long time.
我好久……没有说出这个名字了……

dataList.place:
A Certain Castle, Past
过去，某座城堡

dataList.content:
A human. At my mansion.
有人类。在我的宅邸里。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

Family
家族
dataList.content:
A-apologies, your worship. We should never have let her through, but she... she wields all kinds of fantastical weapons. She demanded to be granted audience with you, Father.
十、十分抱歉……当然她本该由我们处理……但她无论如何都要直接和亲族大人见面……来这里的一路上还挥舞着各种各样的武器……

A Bloodfiend Hunter, are you? And you've managed to break through my Children's vigilance?
血魔猎人吗？我的子嗣们可不是那么轻易就能通过的。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
... I commend your skill, human. It cannot have been easy.
我称赞你有本事能来到这里，人类。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
So, what is it that you seek from this audience?
所以，你的来访理由是？
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Is your wish... to be obliterated without a trace? Or is it to join my Family?
难道……你想要不留痕迹地消失吗？还是想成为我的家族中的一员？
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
... Neither.
……都不是。

I am here to challenge you to a duel.
我……是为了与你决斗才来访的。

... A duel.
……决斗。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
I am not like the other Bloodfiends; I have no interest in killing humans for sport.
我可不像其他血魔那样，为了打发无聊而去杀人。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
However, I am also not so generous a Bloodfiend to let a human who dared to walk into her own doom simply saunter away without consequences.
然而，我也不是那种慈悲的血魔，能让一个自己踏入此地，向我寻死的人类就这么毫发无损地走掉。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Humans and Bloodfiends are at war out there. Did you know that?
人类和血魔正在外面开战。你知道吗？

Just a pit fight between unquenchable Bloodfiends and humans who learned to transmute their hatred into delight.
不过是为血而疯狂的血魔们与将憎恶变为快乐的人类们的丑陋战争罢了。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
I care not for such degeneracy.
我对那些丑恶不感兴趣。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Why do you refuse to take a side?
你为何不选一边站？

Should a Family of your might take a side... it would mean the decisive end of the war.
若是你这样的家族选择了其中一个阵营，战况肯定会发生偏斜。

Haven't I already told you? Or does your fleeting human life require a simpler explanation?
我说过了吧。还是我要为了短命的人类解释得更详细一点呢。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
I would prefer not to dirty my clothes in a pit fight. I refuse to bring myself down to that level.
我讨厌弄脏衣服。我可不想让自己陷入污泥里。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
... Is that so.
……这样啊。

I... am here to do one of two things. One, convince you. Or two, should my first option prove unfeasible, slay you.
我……是来说服你的，或者讨伐你的。

Because you are more dangerous than both of them when you're sitting here and doing nothing.
因为什么都不做的你……比哪方势力都要危险。

So, duel me.
所以与我决斗吧。

You won't get a chance like this again.
拒绝就太过可惜了吧。

Because I know exactly what you seek.
因为我知道你需要的是什么。

Aha...
啊哈……
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Not even I am privy to that knowledge...
连我，都不知道自己需要什么……
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
... yet a human, who knows me not, who has only met me for the first time today, claims to know that?
一个没见过我、不了解我的人类，称她知道那个是什么？
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
I know you Bloodfiends.
我了解你们血魔。

Those blessed with longer lives than humans, yet cursed to live in greater miseries for every second of that longer life.
比人类活得更久，却比人类更为不幸。

I just changed the carpets of this hall. I do not wish to dirty it with lowly human blood.
我这次换了新地毯。我可不想让它被区区人类的血给弄脏。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Leave, and my Children outside this mansion will deal with you.
在我宅邸外的子嗣们会处理你的吧。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Should you employ your Children to kill me...
如果你命令血魔们就这么杀了我的话……

You will never learn the source of your suffering. You will remain unchanging, stagnant, steeped in your misery...
你就不会知晓那不幸的根源从何而来，就像如今这样度过一生……

... until one day, the memory of this moment returns to you as regret.
总有一日，你会想起我来访的那天而后悔的吧。

... Father.
……父亲。
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:
If you would allow me, I will quietly take care of this interloper.
我会安静地处理掉那个人的。
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:
Grab your weapon.
拿起武器。

Answer my duel...
回应我的决斗的话……

... and I promise you upon my honor as a Fixer, that I will grant you what you truly seek.
我就作为收尾人起誓。我会给予你所期望的东西。

I can... give you...
我……可以给你……

No human, let alone a Bloodfiend, has ever matched me evenly in strength.
没有人类能和我势均力敌。当然，也没有血魔。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Then I suppose I shall have the honor of being the first human to do so.
那么我……会成为与你第一个对峙的人类。

... How intriguing.
……多么令人感兴趣。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
The duel continued for three days.
那场战斗持续了三天。

Three days without a victor.
仍然没有胜利者。

... Why not take a brief respite?
……差不多该休息了吧。
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:
It has been three days.
已经过去三天了。
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:
... Three days?
……过去三天了吗？
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Yes, there's been three sunrises and sunsets. I'm quite certain that makes it three days.
日升日落已经重复了三次，没错。
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:
But we are yet to decide a victor.
但是我们还没决出胜者是谁。
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
... Too bad.
……没办法。

At times like these, we must each take enough rest to recover...
这种时候双方都需要充分的休息……

... and duel again at a later date. I will return.
然后再战。所以我还会再来的。

You would stop the battle before it ends, allow your enemy to rest... and even promise to reconvene at a later date?
明明没有决出胜负，却让敌人休息……还要等时机合适时再战？
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Who decided that these odd rules would become laws?
真奇怪，这样的规矩是谁定的？
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
Fixers.
收尾人。

It's a law of the Fixers.
这是收尾人的规矩。

... Father allowed that human to leave. He did not even sic us Children on her, and that was that.
……父亲真的让那个人类回去了。他也没让子嗣们去追她，真的就只是让她平安无事地回去了。
Will you truly let her leave, just like that? A human who so insolently warned you, of all Bloodfiends, that she would return? 您真的就让她那么回去了吗？让那个警告说还会来访的人类诶？

Family
家族

dataList.content:
It is their 'law' she says.
她不是说那是规矩吗。

Father
亲族

Father
亲族

dataList.content:

又来了啊，桑丘啊。你去告诉她，父亲很忙。

Go tell her yourself.
您直接去和她说不就好了。

dataList.content:

Family
家族

What joy does that woman get out of this altercation? She could have at least had the courtesy to arrive at our gates with hands full of refreshments...
这里有什么好的，要来那么多次啊。反正她都是要来，要是两手拎着很多点心来就好了……

家族

dataList.content:
By the... why did I ever agree to something so vexatious?
啊啊，怎会如此……
dataList.title:
Father
亲族

dataList.content:
It is about time we put an end to this, Father.
差不多该做个了断了吧？

Family
家族

dataList.content:
I find no joy in telling you this, but...
虽然我说这话可能有些那个……
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:
... It does not befit your reputation to be locked in a duel with a mere human for so long.
但您不该和人类战斗那么长时间。
dataList.title:
Family
家族

dataList.content:

在其他子嗣中已经开始传言了。

Family
家族

... You will understand the pain of dealing with Children when you make Kindreds of your own.
……你要是也早点创造出家人就能理解我的心情了吧。子嗣们让亲族烦恼的心情。

亲族

我不是说过很多次了吗，我不。

亲族

不论如何，我打算在今天了结这一切。

亲族

不用我帮忙真的没关系吗。

不是说是决斗吗。决斗就要公正地进行。

收尾人到底是什么东西？

亲族

dataList.content:
What is this 'Fixer', that has made you so pertinacious and... stubborn?
那到底是什么，能让你这样执拗地去做麻烦事啊。

亲族

dataList.content:
You have mentioned their laws on our first bout as well... Is the honor of Fixers so significant that you would wager your life on it?
你从最开始就是这样……那所谓的收尾人是值得你赌上性命发誓的高贵荣誉吗？

随后二人同时放下了武器。

dataList.content: You're looking forward to her arrival now, aren't you? You are waiting for her. 您现在已经很期待她的到来了吧。
